For E33G, define precisely: employer abroad, no Indonesian clients, no Indonesian-source income — which of these are explicit legal conditions vs operational practice? May an E33G holder's foreign employer have Indonesian customers if the holder does not serve them?
May an E33G remote worker serve Indonesian clients or invoice an Indonesian entity at all, even minor? Where is the line?
Family members of an E33G holder: which codes attach and with what rights?
Freelancer with mixed foreign+Indonesian income: which lawful configurations exist (E33G vs E23 vs none)?

May E33/E33E holders work or own/manage a business? Quote the prohibition or permission.
E33/E33E → KITAP: is there a conversion path and after how long?

Health-insurance requirements for retirement/second-home permits: which sources impose them and with what minimums?
